label: Can off-hand hits proc Windfury Totem?
short: Main-hand hits only, per client 70425's description.
description: Forever's totem is a raid aura, but client 70425's description says "Each main hand hit has a 20% chance", as in Era.
source: Forever client 70425 (totem description).

settings.label: Main hand only
settings.value: only main-hand hits can proc it

label: How often does raid damage hit a DPS?
short: Each hit can fire a shield, give Rage or push back a cast.
description: Every DPS takes 2 hits a minute of 1500 damage, from boss timers. They take no health but fire Lightning Shield orbs (one per 3.5s), Water Shield globes or a Troll priest's Shadowguard, give a warrior Rage and Enrage (about 9.2 Rage a hit) and push back casts.
source: SoD boss timers in Deadly Boss Mods (Ragnaros, Broodlord, Firemaw, Chromaggus, Huhuran, Kel'Thuzad, Sapphiron).

label: Does throwing a Goblin Land Mine reset the swing?
short: Yes: its 1s cast resets the swing like any cast with a cast time.
description: Casts with a cast time reset the melee swing under Forever, and the sim gives the Land Mine a 1s cast. The melee rotations throw it just after a main hand swing. Client 70338's Land Mine (4100) is instant, which would leave the swing alone and give back about 1% to a melee build.
source: wowsims/forever 4fb2849945 (casts reset the swing). Forever client 70338 (spell 4100).

settings.label: Resets the swing
settings.value: the 1s cast holds the swing and restarts it
settings.rationale: Casts with a cast time reset the swing.

label: Is the boss in Hyjal or the Barrow Deeps?
short: Some flasks give their full bonus only there. The presets assume yes.
description: Forever's Flasks of Natural Accuracy, Aggression, Precision and Swiftness give 60 Stamina anywhere. In Hyjal and the Barrow Deeps they also give 5% hit, 4% crit, 5% less chance to be dodged or parried, or 5% haste. The presets assume the fight is there, and take one of these flasks when it beats the Flask of Supreme Power. Elsewhere, hunters and cat druids go back to the Flask of Distilled Wisdom, and the others keep their flask for its Stamina.
source: Forever client (spells 1293740 to 1293743). wowsims/forever's consumables_natural_flasks.go.

label: Do bosses partly resist spells by level?
short: No: Forever's own resist formula has no level term, and beta mobs above us never partly resisted.
description: Classic bosses partly resisted about 6% of non-binary spell damage, 2% for each level above you. Forever's resist comes from school resistance alone (the sim uses resistance / (resistance + 9 × caster level) from wowsims/forever's combat logs; the character sheet shows 0.75 × resistance / (5 × caster level)), and about 520 beta hits on mobs 3 to 5 levels up showed no partial resist, while mobs with school resistance resisted part of every hit in 10% steps. No boss is tested yet.
source: Beta logs (0 partials in about 520 hits at +3 to +5). Forever's character sheet formula, 0.75 × resistance / (5 × caster level), with no level term (client UI, Camelot/PaperDollFrameStats.lua). wowsims/forever's logs (ed4b4e93e5: none in thousands of hits on mobs 1 to 9 levels up; the resist model since 2026-10-23, e04953fb98). Classic's level rule (royalgiraffe's resist guide).

settings.label: None
settings.rationale: Forever's resist formula and the beta logs.

label: How hard do bleed ticks crit?
short: 200%, like a melee crit: bleeds roll the physical crit.
description: Client 70425 gives the bleeds the periodic-crit flag, and the sim crits their ticks for 200%, the physical crit multiplier, as wowsims/forever does. The only measured tick crits are spell ticks, at 150%.
source: Client 70425 (periodic crit on bleeds). wowsims/forever OutcomeTickPhysicalCrit (the physical crit multiplier).

label: Does Rage from hits grow with level?
short: No: a level 13 log gives the same Rage per hit testers measured at 30.
description: A landed white hit gives 3.46 × weapon speed (4.5 for a two-hander) at every level. Arlewow's level 13 log gives 6.2 to 6.3 Rage a 1.8s main hand swing, 3.46 × 1.8, the k testers measured at level 30, so k didn't grow from 13 to 30. At 60 a swing gives about half of Classic's Rage.
source: Arlewow's combat log (gist a622100ad149f4fc31ddf95f9b3aab2c, level 13). Level 30 beta tests (forum thread 2355684). wowsims/forever sim/core/rage.go (BaseRageHitFactor 3.46 / 4.5, no level scaling).

settings.label: Flat (level 30 value)
settings.value: Rage per hit stays at its level 30 value
settings.rationale: The level 13 log matches the level 30 k.

label: Do off-hand hits give full Rage?
short: Half the Rage of a main-hand hit of the same speed, from a beta log.
description: A beta log shows a 1.6s off-hand dagger giving 2.7 to 2.8 Rage a swing, half a main-hand swing, glancing blows included. Dual Wield Specialization's 10% a point adds to it.
source: Arlewow's combat log (gist a622100ad149f4fc31ddf95f9b3aab2c, magey/forever-warrior issue 3, level 13).

label: How much attack power does Rend get?
short: 2% of attack power a tick, measured on rank 2 by wowsims/forever.
description: Blizzard says Rend scales strongly with attack power, but the client has no number. wowsims/forever measured 2% of attack power a tick on rank 2, about 14% over a full Rend.
source: Blizzard's warrior notes. Forever client 70338. wowsims/forever 1172f1c745 (rank 2 logs, level 13 and 14: 7 + 0.02 × attack power a tick).

label: Do our stances change Rage from hits taken?
short: No: Rage comes from the attacker's hit before any of our mitigation.
description: The logs fit Rage from damage taken on the hit before the defender's mitigation: the defender's health, armor and gear don't move it. The sim counts none of our damage taken modifiers (stances, Shield Wall, Recklessness, blocks), only crits and crushing blows.
source: wowsims/forever ee2d69b16a, 73b317c7cf (post-8 October logs, geared and naked). Blizzard's 8 October notes. Settled 2026-10-23 (b3f15c1d13).

settings.label: None count
settings.value: the attacker's hit, before anything of ours

label: Rage from a hit taken at 60
short: Measured on melee hits, and the sim uses the same factor for the raid hits.
description: The sim gives 2.5 × (1 − assumed armor) × damage / the Rage conversion at the attacker's level, the armor by the attacker's level (40% at 63), fitted on melee hits from attackers 16 to 60 after the 8 October build. The raid hits are spells, which landed at 1 to 2 times it in the logs.
source: wowsims/forever ee2d69b16a, 73b317c7cf and de550b7df9 (combat logs; their spell TODO: ticks about 2x, Fireball about 1.2x). Blizzard's 8 October notes.

settings.label: 2.5 (melee fit)
settings.value: 9.2 Rage for a 1500 hit from the boss

label: How much does the pet inherit?
short: 10% of the hunter's attack power, read on a pet sheet, and the hunter's hit.
description: A level 17 pet sheet at two gear states reads 10% of the hunter's attack power and the hunter's crit. Blizzard gives the hunter's ranged hit as the pet's melee hit and 17/8 of it as spell hit. The pet's own attack power is a fixed 254 at 60.
source: wowsims/forever 643d636345, 684209eb0a, 9ce48b6aba (forever-bugs #394). Settled 2026-10-23 (972736c67b).

settings.label: 10% AP + hit (measured)
settings.value: 10% of ranged attack power, the hunter's crit and hit, 17/8 of the hit as spell hit

label: Do fast pets hit as hard as slow pets?
short: No: a fast pet's hits are smaller, as in Classic. A level 17 pet sheet fits it.
description: Beta players saw every pet hit like a 2.0s pet. wowsims/forever's level 17 Cat sheet at 1.5s fits (creature damage + attack power / 14) × 1.5 × 1.1, so a fast pet's hits are smaller and every pet's white damage a second is the same, as the presets have it. Cobra Reflexes' faster swing shrinks the hits the same way.
source: wowsims/forever 643d636345 (level 17 Cat sheet). Beta players (ForeverChanges' hunter pets page, forever-hunter wiki). Settled 2026-10-25.

settings.label: Scales with speed (Classic)
settings.value: a fast pet's hits are smaller
settings.rationale: The level 17 pet sheet fits it.

label: How much does Cobra Reflexes cut pet hits?
short: +30% attack speed "but reduces damage", with no number. Each hit shrinks with the speed.
description: With hits that shrink with the speed (as with pet attack speed), Cobra Reflexes adds only Pet Aggression's 8 a hit on the extra swings and the procs. wowsims/forever keeps The Burning Crusade's 15% cut instead, which nets 10.5% more white damage.
source: Forever client 70532 (spell 25076, A_MOD_ATTACKSPEED 30). wowsims/forever pets.go (TBC 0.85).

settings.label: Hits shrink with speed
settings.value: each hit ×1/1.3, the same white damage a second
settings.rationale: The same as pet attack speed.
